note: demo-wrong-credit in English, for viewers who don't speak Hindi: a written demo script of the 'sent too much by mistake' scam, as an elder we phoned on Oct 31, 2026 described the call that cost him Rs 20,000. Not a real call: the names are made up, and the voices are synthetic.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello uncle, this is Ramesh, Suresh's friend. Suresh asked me to send you 25,000 rupees.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm sending it right now on Google Pay. You'll get a message on your phone, please check.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uncle, did the message come? Oh no, I sent 45,000 instead of 25,000 by mistake. My finger pressed the wrong number.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uncle please, send the extra 20,000 back to this same number. I have to pay it at the hospital right now, please hurry.
